title: Art. 3.33 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, H. Inspection of travel documents, 3.33
content: Aircraft operators shall take necessary precautions at the point of embarkation to ensure that persons are in possession of the documents prescribed by the States of transit and destination for control purposes as described in this chapter.
